subject: Eval timetable + evidence staging — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA checklist
messages:
From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@clearwave.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@clearwave.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval kickoff — security gates & evidence timeline

Jordan — thanks for the intro call earlier this week. We discussed a mutual action plan to get ClearWave through procurement. Two quick asks up front so we can sequence our security team: 1) tentative timeline for SOC 2 evidence review (we need to sync on which controls you'll share vs. what we verify with attestations), and 2) confirmation on DPA redlines — our legal team will send initial edits but we need a target date for agreement so we can schedule an ops integration window.

Also, are you able to confirm your default data retention tiers (session logs, customer data, embeddings) and whether we can request a shorter retention for our account during the pilot? Attaching a short checklist from our side would help.

Thanks — Alex
Lead Security PM, ClearWave Financial

Attachments: (requested) procurement-checklist-template.xlsx

From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@clearwave.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff — security gates & evidence timeline

Alex — thanks, appreciate the clear asks. High level response and proposed MAP attached.

Short answers: 
- SOC 2: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II report (last attestation Q4 2026) and a control mapping spreadsheet for the specific control IDs you called out. Target: evidence bundle to you within 7 business days after you confirm controls in scope.
- DPA: our legal team (cc Kim) can turn on the DPA redline thread. We typically aim to reach agreement within 10 business days for standard requests; if there are carve-outs we'll escalate to Contracts.
- Retention: default is 30 days for session logs, 180 days for embeddings by default, and 365 days for customer uploads. We can enable a pilot retention profile (14d logs / 90d embeddings) for a timeboxed pilot — need a PO or SOW to enable via our provisioning flow.

I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (RW_MAP_v1.xlsx) with checkpoints, owners, and dates. If that looks like a workable cadence I'll loop in Soojin to schedule a focused evidence intake workshop next week.

-Jordan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: RW_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@clearwave.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@clearwave.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@clearwave.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 14:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff — security gates & evidence timeline

Jordan — reviewed the MAP. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) SOC 2 scope: we only need the security and availability trust services (control IDs listed inline). Can you confirm whether you redact customer-specific identifiers in the evidence artifacts? Our compliance team won't accept raw tenant logs.

2) DPA: Daniel will push a narrow set of redlines (key point: audit rights and subprocessors list). Can you get Procurement to add a clause for a 30-day SLA for evidence requests during onboarding? That timeline is important for our timelines.

3) Retention: pilot profile is fine, but we need written confirmation that we can revert to default after the pilot ends and a process to request deletion earlier if needed (API + manual).

If you can send an updated MAP with those items and a one-page SOC 2 evidence index we can share with our GRC team. Goal: close compliance runway by Apr 22 so we can start integration in May.

On Tue, Apr 6, 2027 at 10:07 AM jordan.blake@redwood.com wrote: > I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan...

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@clearwave.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@clearwave.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff — security gates & evidence timeline (MAP update)

Alex / Daniel — looping legal & evidence ops. Please see the attached updated MAP and a SOC 2 evidence index (SOC2-summary.pdf). Highlights: 

- Evidence redaction: we provide redacted artifacts for tenant-specific logs. Redaction rules: strip user identifiers and account numbers; provide aggregated request traces with timestamps. Detailed examples are included in the index.
- Evidence SLA: we can commit to a 30 calendar day response window for standard evidence requests during onboarding. For time-sensitive production-impact requests we offer an expedited 5 business day path (subject to scope and PO).
- DPA redlines: we've incorporated three of your asks and added commentary inline in DPA_redline_v2.docx. Two items need legal approval (audit rights language + subprocessors addendum).
- Retention API / delete flow: confirmed — we provide both an API to trigger account-scoped deletion and manual support to process expedited requests. Pilot profile (14d/90d) is configurable and will revert to default after the pilot; this will be documented in the SOW.

Next steps proposed: 
1) ClearWave to confirm control IDs you want in-scope (reply to this thread).
2) Sign off on MAP and DPA redlines (we'll send DocuSign for approved DPA text).
3) Evidence intake workshop: Soojin to propose two 60-minute slots next week.

Kim
Sr. Security & Compliance Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: DPA_redline_v2.docx, SOC2-summary.pdf, RW_MAP_v1.xlsx

From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@clearwave.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@clearwave.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@clearwave.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff — security gates & evidence timeline (MAP update)

Thanks Kim — that looks good. Daniel confirms the DPA edits and will sign the DocuSign once we get the final text. We're confirming the control IDs (security + availability only) and will reply with the list by EOD.

Agree to the 30-day evidence SLA with the expedited 5 business day path for critical items — that meets our procurement bar. We'll accept the pilot retention profile and expect the SOW wording you mentioned. Please send the DocuSign for the DPA and a calendar invite for the evidence intake workshop (Maya + I will attend).

Alex
Lead Security PM, ClearWave Financial

---
Summary of thread: Mutual Action Plan drafted and updated to include artifact redaction rules, evidence SLA (30 days + expedited 5 business day path), configurable pilot retention profile (14d/90d), and DPA redlines queued for DocuSign. Next milestone: Close compliance runway by 2027-04-22 and start integration in May.
